==Usage==
Paste <code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>Deprecated|{{Var|new template}}}}</code> at the top of the template's documentation. Additionally, paste <code><nowiki><includeonly>[[Category:Pages with deprecated templates]]</includeonly></nowiki></code> on the deprecated template's page itself.

===Required parameters===
#{{Para||{{Var|new template}}}} A link to the replacement template.

==Categorization==
